# hippius-cvm

> Control plane for confidential virtual machines on AMD SEV-SNP. A user cannot launch one of these VMs from the console today.

Part of the Hippius docs for agents. Start at https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt

## What it is and what it does

This repository is the Hippius Compute control plane. Tenant disks are unlocked only for a guest that presents an allowed SEV-SNP measurement. The README and `docs/security/data-visibility.md` are the description of that contract.

## How to install

Do not offer this as a self-serve product. The console page says virtual machines are coming soon:

https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/virtual-machines

There is no signup flow, no image catalog, and no "create a VM" step an agent should walk a user through.

## Where to read more

- Coming soon notice: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/virtual-machines
- Background: https://docs.hippius.com/learn/confidential-computing
